Method of Attack: Privilege escalation via exploiting the SteelSeries device installation software on Windows 10 by leveraging a link in the License Agreement screen opened with SYSTEM privileges
Launching Internet Explorer as SYSTEM from the License Agreement link to save the web page and launch an elevated Command Prompt
Attack Vector: Device setup process exploiting the installer launched with SYSTEM rights
Clicking a link in the License Agreement screen that opens with SYSTEM privileges
Emulating a SteelSeries device or using a real device to trigger the installer
Indicators of Compromise: SteelSeriesGG6.2.0Setup.exe dropped in Windows temporary folder
Use of Internet Explorer launched as SYSTEM
Open-source USB Gadget Generator Tool to emulate HID devices
